dsh-permissions is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-211c77daa72149d09221.html
